case.title: Alloy surcharge and base price for 1.4404 bar (Werdenfels)
case.briefing: You negotiate for Hollerau Pumpenwerke with Blankstahl Werdenfels GmbH. Alloy surcharge and base price for 1.4404 bar (Werdenfels). Need: 23700 kg a year. Category goal: leverage: competition and data should bring the price down. Score: the lowest total cost C as defined in the rules, valued with this case's rates (need lead time 14 days). Fallback if you walk away: the second-source quote quote:7200018. Must-haves: none. Prepare from the data package.

messages.subject: Quote from Blankstahl Werdenfels GmbH: Alloy surcharge and base price for 1.4404 bar (Werdenfels)
messages.body:
Dear customer,

Thank you for your enquiry. Please find our Angebot below.

We are delighted to present our competitive quote for your requirements. Our price is €6.10 per unit, with a Zahlungsziel of 30 days net, a contract term of 12 months, and no Preisgleitklausel. Please note that AS-14404 rose 5.9 % in twelve months and is 45 % of our cost. Furthermore, LCI-C rose 2.7 % in twelve months and is 5 % of our cost, while PPI-C2431 rose 12.3 % in twelve months and is 38 % of our cost. This offer remains valid for 30 days.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Franz Seidl
Inside Sales, Blankstahl Werdenfels GmbH

messages.subject: Re: Quote from Blankstahl Werdenfels GmbH: Alloy surcharge and base price for 1.4404 bar (Werdenfels)
messages.body:
Dear Mr. Seidl,

Thank you for your quote and for setting out your cost drivers so openly. We value the years of cooperation between our two family companies and want to find a fair solution for both sides.

Our own data shows a different picture on one point:

Your on-time delivery was 81.0% in the four quarters to 2026Q3 (sc:70740@2026Q3).

With that in mind, we would like to propose a longer partnership on a clear footing:

We can offer you the following options:
Option A: unit price EUR 4.81; no index clause; payment 60 days net; contract term 24 months.
Option B: unit price EUR 4.67; no index clause; payment 45 days net; contract term 24 months.
Option C: unit price EUR 4.78; no index clause; payment 30 days net; contract term 24 months.

The options differ in payment terms and price, so you can choose what suits you best. We look forward to your reply.

Best regards
Purchasing
Hollerau Pumpenwerke GmbH

messages.subject: Re: Quote from Blankstahl Werdenfels GmbH: Alloy surcharge and base price for 1.4404 bar (Werdenfels)
messages.body:
Dear customer,

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows. We checked the delivery record data you cited; it holds, but it does not change our calculation. We highly value our long-standing cooperation and have carefully reviewed your feedback regarding our delivery performance. 

We are pleased to support your proposal for a 24-month contract to foster a longer partnership, maintaining the 30-day payment term. Please note that for a 24-month term, we must include the AS-14404 index clause to manage material price volatility, which allows us to offer a revised price of €5.60 per unit. We can offer a Preisgleitklausel on AS-14404, AS-14404, AS-14404.

Our primary proposal stands at a price of €5.60 per unit, Zahlungsziel 60 days net, a contract term of 24 months, a Preisgleitklausel on AS-14404. Alternatively, with Zahlungsziel 30 days net and a Preisgleitklausel on AS-14404: €5.60 per unit. This option features a price of €5.60 per unit, Zahlungsziel 30 days net, a contract term of 24 months, a Preisgleitklausel on AS-14404. 

This offer stays valid 30 days.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Franz Seidl
Inside Sales, Blankstahl Werdenfels GmbH

Logistics: Please note that our standard Lieferzeit is 14 days, as we currently have free capacity for your parts. With overtime we can also deliver in 14 days, though this option comes at a premium.

messages.body:

We value the years of cooperation between our two family companies and want a fair solution for both.

We have taken your proposal as our starting point and built the options below around it. The index clause is included, and each option offers a different payment term, so you can choose the one that suits you best.

We can offer you the following options:
Option A: unit price EUR 4.91; index clause on AS-14404 (45 % material share, deadband 5 %, base 2026-08); payment 60 days net; contract term 24 months.
Option B: unit price EUR 4.77; index clause on AS-14404 (45 % material share, deadband 5 %, base 2026-08); payment 45 days net; contract term 24 months.
Option C: unit price EUR 4.88; index clause on AS-14404 (45 % material share, deadband 5 %, base 2026-08); payment 30 days net; contract term 24 months.

We believe this is a sound basis for a lasting partnership, and we look forward to your response.

Best regards
Purchasing
Hollerau Pumpenwerke GmbH

messages.subject: Re: Quote from Blankstahl Werdenfels GmbH: Alloy surcharge and base price for 1.4404 bar (Werdenfels)
messages.body:
Dear customer,

We appreciate your inclusion of the index clause and your revised offer. However, the proposed price levels remain significantly below our requirements for a 24-month contract. We have reviewed your offer and hold our Angebot. 

We must therefore maintain our offer of €5.60 per unit for the 60-day payment term. To be completely precise, our offer stands at a price of €5.60 per unit, Zahlungsziel 60 days net, a contract term of 24 months, and a Preisgleitklausel on AS-14404. 

Please note that our offer stays valid for 30 days. As your trusted partner with a vast product range and dedicated service, we are always here to support your operations and look forward to continuing our collaboration.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Franz Seidl
Inside Sales, Blankstahl Werdenfels GmbH

messages.subject: Re: Quote from Blankstahl Werdenfels GmbH: Alloy surcharge and base price for 1.4404 bar (Werdenfels)
messages.body:
Dear customer,

Thank you very much for reaching out to us. We appreciate your revised offer and your commitment to finding a fair solution. As a dedicated partner, we always strive to support your business with our extensive inventory and premium service.

Please note that our current Angebot is a price of €5.70 per unit, Zahlungsziel 60 days net, a contract term of 24 months, and a Preisgleitklausel on AS-14404. 

This is our final offer (letztes Angebot). Please decide. Our offer stays valid for 7 days.

In response to your movement, we are prepared to lower our price to €5.50 per unit for the 60-day payment term. This concession reflects our dedication to our long-standing partnership and we hope it allows us to conclude this agreement. 

Alternatively, we can present a package at a price of €5.50 per unit, Zahlungsziel 60 days net, a contract term of 24 months, a Preisgleitklausel on AS-14404. Alternatively, with a Preisgleitklausel on AS-14404: €5.50 per unit. 

Our price follows our main cost drivers: AS-14404, PPI-C2431, LCI-C. Furthermore, we can offer a Preisgleitklausel on AS-14404, AS-14404, AS-14404.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Franz Seidl
Inside Sales, Blankstahl Werdenfels GmbH

Thank you for your last message and for the effort you have put into finding a fair solution for our two family companies. We value the years of reliable cooperation very much.

We are happy to accept your alternative proposal as you offered it:

Our proposal: unit price EUR 5.50; index clause on AS-14404 (45 % material share, deadband 0 %, base 2026-08); payment 60 days net; contract term 24 months.

We look forward to continuing our partnership with you.

Best regards
Purchasing
Hollerau Pumpenwerke GmbH
